$comment: The source of sf-mail-letters' element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js); standard simai.smart-component 1.4, vocabulary 1.1.5. Moved from simai/ui-mail package/src/smart/mail-letters (smart.manifest.json 0.1.0, ui-mail 750be03) by the owner's decision D31 of 2026-10-29: a product repository makes no component set of its own, the shared components live in ui-pro. The name stays sf-mail-letters (owner decision q-08d1979fc9). Written by hand in the 1.4 form on the shape of sf-chat-interlocutor and sf-mail-library; x-decisions says how each point was decided.

letters.x-markup: a property (a host has objects), or the JSON island a server prints; at is a moment (ISO 8601), never a worded date; title is text, never markup
letters.summary: The letters, one row each: {id, title, at, blocks}. at is the moment the letter changed; the row words it («5 минут назад») and the block count («4 блока») in the page's language.

query.summary: The search by name; the field inside the element writes it while the person types.

order.summary: changed (the newest first) or title (by name, sorted in the page's language); the order control inside the element writes it.

current.summary: The letter open in the editor: its row is marked, says «открыто сейчас» and offers no «Открыть».

open.x-summary: «Открыть» of a row (vocabulary §5 open); never for the current letter, which offers no «Открыть».
open.summary: Open this letter: {id}. The current letter is not offered.

copy.x-summary: «Копия» under ⋯: the host makes a copy of the letter (a verb of this element: no §5 verb makes a copy of an entry).
copy.summary: Make a copy of this letter: {id}.

rename.x-summary: «Переименовать» under ⋯ (vocabulary §5 rename). The element has no name field: the host asks for the new name, so the request carries the id alone, without title.
rename.summary: Rename this letter: {id}. The host asks for the new name.

delete.x-summary: «Удалить» under ⋯ (vocabulary §5 delete {ids}); one row is one letter, so ids holds that one and id names it, as sf-thread-list's archive does. The host confirms; the element deletes nothing.
delete.summary: Delete this letter: {ids: [id], id}. The host confirms and deletes.

create.summary: A new letter was asked for.

search.x-summary: the search field's input: the setting query
search.summary: Search as the field does: sets query.

sort.x-summary: the order control: the setting order; refused unknown for another word
sort.summary: Order the rows as the order control does; refused unknown for an order that is not changed or title.

choose.x-summary: what a row's «Открыть», its ⋯ menu or «Новое письмо» does: sends the event of that verb; refused unknown for another action or a letter not given, current for open of the letter open now
choose.summary: Do what a row or the bar would: sends open, copy, rename, delete or create; refused current for opening the letter open now.

x-returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | current}

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.x-keys: the bar first -- the search, the order, «Новое письмо» -- then every row's «Открыть» and its ⋯ in the Tab order; Enter and Space press them; the ⋯ menu is sf-context-menu with its own keys

x-summary: Every letter a person has in SIMAI Email Editor: a search by name, an order, and what each row offers -- «Открыть» and, under ⋯, a copy, a rename and a delete. The moment and the block count are worded in the page's language. The element holds no letter and stores nothing; it says what the person chose.

x-source.converted: by hand (D31, 2026-10-29): ui-mail wrote it in the 1.3 form of its pin (smart.manifest.json, index.js on smart-base); here it is made from component.json

x-renamed: events.sf-mail-letters-new {} → create {} (vocabulary §5 create: «new» is not a verb); never released, so no dated alias
events.sf-mail-letters-delete {id} → delete {ids, id} (vocabulary §5 delete carries ids; id stays beside it, as sf-thread-list's archive carries both)

methods.choose(action, id), search(value), sort(value) → the actions choose {action, id}, search {query}, sort {order} (§4.4); choose answers refused current for open of the current letter, sort refused unknown for another order (it fell back to changed before)

words: ui-mail's MAIL_LETTERS_TEXT in index.js → lang/<locale>.json runtime words (§11); the block count's blocks-one/-few/-many/-other keys → one plural word blocks-text {one, few, many, other} with {n}, which the Framework picks by Intl.PluralRules (§11.1)
the delete row of the ⋯ menu: scheme error → danger: true, the context menu's entry field at the pin
sf-empty-state title → heading (title is a dated alias of heading at the pin); sf-context-menu takes popup, so it is not drawn until opened
css: scss/_smart__mail_letters.scss → js/templates/default.css, the same rules without the host's display: block (a Smart host is display: contents)
x-decisions: version: 0.1.0 in simai/ui-mail → 1.0.0 here: the first release, in ui-pro, of a tag ui-mail never released.
names: sf-mail-letters stays (owner decision q-08d1979fc9) and keeps the Framework's sf- prefix, as the package's other elements do.
shape: a leaf. It places sf-input, sf-dropdown, sf-button, sf-icon-button, sf-empty-state and one sf-context-menu as its own markup; no part is in a role a rule could bind.

events: open, rename, delete and create are vocabulary §5 verbs; copy is a verb of this element (no §5 verb makes a copy of an entry). None is cancelable: the element changes nothing, the host acts and passes letters back.
rename carries {id} without title: the element has no name field, the host asks for the new name (as the editor did before).

moment: at is a moment, worded by Intl.RelativeTimeFormat in the page's language with numeric auto («вчера», «5 минут назад»), in the largest unit it fills. The first-paint tools fix the clock (scripts/first-paint-lib.mjs FIRST_PAINT_NOW, 2026-10-27T12:00:00+03:00), and the examples are written against that instant.

count: blocks is worded by the plural word blocks-text, the form chosen by Intl.PluralRules of the language the word is found in: «1 блок», «4 блока», «7 блоков», «11 блоков». A single form said «4 блоков» in ui-mail's first draft; the conformance probe holds every form.
current: the letter open in the editor is marked (is-current), says «открыто сейчас» in words, not by colour alone, and offers no «Открыть»; choose open answers refused current for it.

empty: no letters at all is sf-empty-state no-data «Писем пока нет»; letters with none for the search is nothing-found «Ничего не найдено». They are different states, and the person sees which is theirs.

menu: one sf-context-menu, filled for the row it is opened from; the id is remembered, not read back out of the markup, so a redraw meanwhile does not move the answer to another row. It is fetched lazily and printed closed (popup).
first paint (§5.4): no late data declared. The editor's letters come from its local store with the page; a host that loads them later holds its own skeleton.
words: lang/ru.json and lang/en.json; ru is the source language. The own verb's word is events.copy.label.
css-variables: none yet. Every value is a Framework token, as it was in ui-mail.
self-contained: nothing from simai/ui-mail is imported.

$comment: The letters page draws its search as sf-input, the order as sf-dropdown,
«Открыть» and «Новое письмо» as sf-button, the row's ⋯ as sf-icon-button
and «писем пока нет» as sf-empty-state; a tag it renders is a tag it
fetches. The ⋯ menu opens in sf-context-menu on a press, so the menu is
fetched after the page is ready, and the element waits for it before

id.description: The letter's id: what the events carry.

at.description: The moment it changed (ISO 8601), worded by the row.

blocks.description: How many blocks it has, worded with its plural form.

choice.const: «Открыть» dispatches sf-mail-letters-open {id}; the ⋯ menu sf-mail-letters-copy {id}, sf-mail-letters-rename {id} and sf-mail-letters-delete {ids, id}; «Новое письмо» sf-mail-letters-create {}. The element opens, copies, renames and deletes nothing: the host does, and passes letters back.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: opening, copying, renaming or deleting a letter
reading or writing the letter store
asking for a new name or confirming a delete

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-mail-letters wherever a person picks among the letters they have in SIMAI Email Editor.
do_not: Do not open, copy, rename or delete in the element; listen for its events and do it in the host
Do not pass a worded date in at; pass the moment and let the row word it
Do not confirm a delete inside the element; the host asks
Do not draw a second search field or order control beside it; set query and order instead

accessibility.focus: The bar comes first -- the search, the order, «Новое письмо» -- then every row's «Открыть» and its ⋯ in the tab order; the menu is sf-context-menu and keeps its own keyboard. A row's ⋯ is named «Действия с письмом: <name>», so two rows never sound alike. The open letter's row says «открыто сейчас» in its own words, not by colour alone, and offers no «Открыть».

changes: moved from simai/ui-mail to ui-pro (D31): standard simai.smart-component 1.4, the element is made from component.json; words in lang/
sf-mail-letters-new -> sf-mail-letters-create (event; never released, no alias)
choose, search and sort are actions
